messages:
sara: dropped a compact onboarding tray concept (bottom-left) that expands into a quickstart flow. figma: https://figma.com/file/onboard-tray-2026 — please skim :eyes:
tony: nice. quick Q: persistent across devices or session-only? we should decide for telemetry and hide logic.sara: want cross-device persist until sample created or user dismisses. dom: that needs a server flag, client-only localStorage will miss cross-device flows.anya: accessibility notes: collapsed tray must be keyboard-focusable and have an accessible name. current collapsed icon has no focus outline and badge contrast is low.ux-bot: automated a11y scan: collapsed state fails keyboard focus, badge text contrast ratio 2.7:1. expand panel lacks aria-modal and focus-trap on close.dom: implementation plan: client feature flag for show/hide + server flag for dismissal; adding aria-modal and focus return on close will take a touch more time.lee: copy suggestion: verb-first CTA "Create sample" and microcopy "Includes API key and run command". also add copy-button for the CLI snippet to speed first-call.sara: telemetry names proposed: onb.tray_impression, onb.tray_expand, onb.sample_create, onb.sample_dismiss. include experiment cohort id on impressions.anya: also request aria-live="polite" for creation progress and post-create announcement: "Sample ready. Run locally: `redwood samples run <name>`" with copy button.dom: rough timeline: client flag + focusable collapsed icon = 1 sprint; server dismiss + telemetry = additional sprint; modal focus/trap improvements if we convert to true modal = +1 sprint.sara: next steps: 1) dom to prototype client flag + focusable collapsed icon; 2) anya to update comps for contrast and focus states; 3) lee to finalize CTA microcopy and CLI snippet; 4) tony to add telemetry names to experiment ticket. I'll file the ticket and schedule a 5-minute smoke test tomorrow.tony: LGTM — can we recruit two fresh signups for the smoke test? helps validate first-call success.anya: I'll attach a11y test checklist (keyboard nav, screen reader expand, focus return, contrast checks).sara: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-991 — pls comment and add notes. thanks everyone :sparkles:
